## Summary

Describe the change and its user-visible effect.

## Verification

List the exact lightweight checks and any local integration checks you ran.

## Reproducibility checklist

- [ ] I pinned or documented affected runtime revisions, patch order, artifacts, checksums, and commands.
- [ ] I included raw benchmark evidence for any performance or correctness claim.
- [ ] I distinguished measured results, upstream claims, hypotheses, and future work.
- [ ] I did not add model weights, build outputs, third-party source trees, tokens, usernames, or private absolute paths.
- [ ] I updated documentation and manifests needed to reproduce this change.
